text: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅对外发布《关于推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合的意见》。意见提出，健全激励创新的市场环境。破除不合理限制创新产品进入市场的制度障碍，在新业态新领域开展放宽市场准入试点，探索开展承诺即入制。加强新技术应用监管，探索“沙盒监管”方式。推动健全人工智能、生物技术等前沿领域法律法规，完善科技伦理制度规范。
text_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council released the Opinions on Promoting the Deep Integration of Technological Innovation and Industrial Innovation. The Opinions propose improving the market environment that incentivizes innovation. Remove institutional barriers that unreasonably restrict innovative products from entering the market, carry out pilot programs to relax market access in new business forms and new fields, and explore the implementation of a commitment-based entry system. Strengthen supervision over the application of new technologies and explore "sandbox regulation" approaches. Promote the improvement of laws and regulations in frontier fields such as AI and biotechnology, and improve science and technology ethics rules and standards.
